messages:
kate: heads-up — bumped @redwood-inference/sdk to an exports-first package.json (only conditional import/require) and several internal next/vercel sample apps started failing during edge builds with 500s.

nikhil: can you paste the error from the edge bundle?

kate: repro error from vercel build: `Error: Cannot find module '/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk'` when the edge lambda imports the package. Server containers (node:16) work fine.

olivia: that usually means the edge resolver/bundler didn't resolve the conditional exports. what's the current exports map?

kate: current snippet in package.json: "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }, "./types": "./dist/index.d.ts" }

nikhil: two likely issues: (1) some edge bundlers expect a file fallback or `main`/`module` fields; (2) subpath `./types` is hit-and-miss for TypeScript resolution. Many runtime resolvers also look for a root file like `index.js` or `edge.mjs`.

olivia: pragmatic compatibility plan: add legacy fields and explicit fallbacks, plus a tiny root ESM surface for edge runtimes. Example patch that fixed my local vercel dev run:

```json
"main": "./dist/index.cjs",
"module": "./dist/index.mjs",
"types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "browser": "./edge.mjs",
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "default": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./*": "./dist/*.js"
}
```

kate: yes — shipping an `edge.mjs` that does `export * from './dist/index.mjs'` covers platforms that only resolve the package root. Also adding top-level `types` fixes TS consumers.

nikhil: note: we also have a test-only retry helper that uses `require()` dynamically; that fails in ESM-only bundles. We should convert that helper to named ESM exports and, if needed, publish a tiny CJS shim that simply `module.exports = require('./dist/index.cjs')` for older consumers.

olivia: agree. CI caught the regression in the `sample-apps` job during the next edge build step — adding an edge-like smoke runner (vercel dev or bun) to that CI job would prevent regressions from reaching staging.

kate: plan I'm about to ship in the patch branch: 1) restore `main`/`module`/`types`, 2) add `edge.mjs` at package root reexporting ESM, 3) expand `exports` with `browser`, `default`, and wildcard `./*`, 4) replace dynamic require usage, 5) add sample-app edge smoke CI, 6) include a changelog blurb and internal note so teams can pin prior version if needed.

nikhil: please add a README note explaining why `edge.mjs` exists and small migration guidance (next.config/vercel.json snippet) so integrators know how to opt in.

olivia: also consider `typesVersions` for older TS consumers that don't pick up `exports."./types"`.

ci-bot: created branch kate/sdk-exports-compat and queued patch build -> staging.

kate: PR opened with repro, CI logs, and the package.json patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/448 — pinging reviewers.

nikhil: thumbs-up. prefer shipping a compatibility patch instead of a major unless we're intentionally breaking consumers.

olivia: agreed — we should avoid surprises. once patch lands we'll monitor internal sample apps and close the loop.
